method.floor: Actual transformed vertical pipe cylinders recovered from batched triangle geometry; centre+12 perimeter downward rays through actual extruded floor, support board and insulation. A clear intended hole returns no floor-surface hits.
method.walls: Actual pipe triangles vs independently split solid partition boxes;1mm inward tolerance to avoid contact-only reports.
method.structure: Connected structural-piece AABBs produce candidates. Those candidates are refined against ALL actual transformed structural triangles vs cylinder AABB shrunk1mm. The connected perimeter base frame has a large empty interior, so raw component-box hits alone are not failures.
method.terminations: Upper riser ends associated to servicePoints are intentional fixture connection symbols. Fixture cabinet/basin bodies excluded from accidental-collision counts.
method.limits: No hydraulic sizing, drainage slope, joint/flexible connector, sealing, plumbing regulation or manufacturer routing certification. Scheme begins under floor and is not animated as a transport system.
